nodes.name: Workflow Input
nodes.notes: Called by MIG-001 with { migration_id, entity, batch_size, updated_since }.

nodes.name: Load Checkpoint
nodes.notes: Scope §27: resume position comes from BuilderLync, not from n8n execution state. This is what makes a dead n8n execution survivable.

nodes.name: Already Complete?
nodes.notes: A finished entity is skipped on resume rather than re-extracted.

nodes.name: Extract And Normalize
nodes.notes: The ONLY source-specific node in this workflow (Guide §5.5).

nodes.name: Hash Records
nodes.notes: Deterministic content hash for idempotent replay (Scope §11).

nodes.name: Load Batch Into BuilderLync
nodes.notes: Idempotency keys make this safe to retry; BuilderLync deduplicates, validates and persists (Scope §69).

nodes.name: Account For Every Record
nodes.notes: Scope §44: one bad record must not make a batch unaccountable.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ entity: $json.entity, cursor: $json.cursor, records_processed: $json.records_processed, batch_number: $json.batch_number, extraction_complete: !$json.has_more }) }}

nodes.name: Save Checkpoint
nodes.notes: Checkpoint AFTER the batch is accounted for. Ordering matters: checkpointing first would lose a batch on crash.

nodes.name: Next Page
nodes.notes: Loops back to extraction with the stored cursor. n8n's execution-progress saving plus BuilderLync checkpoints mean an interrupted loop resumes, not restarts.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ entity: 'job', error_code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR', message: String($json.error ?? $json.message ?? 'Unknown workflow error'), context: { workflow: 'MIG-140' } }) }}

nodes.name: Report Error
nodes.notes: Errors are recorded in BuilderLync so they appear in the customer's error dashboard (Scope §35), not only in n8n execution logs.

meta.description: Per-entity migration workflow for job (Guide §5.4). Extraction and transformation are isolated in one node; everything else is shared by all connectors (Guide §5.5). Resume position and error state live in BuilderLync, never in n8n.
